content: Even smaller is CoRoT-7b, first planet discovered in the domain of Super-Earth size planets. The planet orbits in 0.8 days a K0 main sequence star which is one of the brightest star in the first long run. The transit is 0.35 mmag deep but is clearly detected in the Fourier transform of the light curve. Detection of super-Earth size planets requires bright host stars because the shallow transit depth demands high photometric precision.
